correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the complete 27-boundary-triple minimum-plus-count recursion, color-orbit AAA/AAB/ABC reduction and induction on consecutive minima x,x+1,x+2; root-edge costs show E_t/J=(3^(t-1)+1)/2, D_t=18b_t+6c_t. Independent exact recurrence at t=0..6 gave (energy,degeneracy) (0,6),(1,36),(2,72),(5,216),(14,6480),(41,468163800),(122,5643087076554259583661696). The recurrences for r_t=a_t/b_t imply s_(t+1)=2s_t+eps_t and u_(t+1)=3u_t+Delta_t; superexponential growth and summable tails yield log D_t = c 3^t - k 2^t +log18+o(1). Finite check supports, not replaces, induction/asymptotic convergence.
